summary: Iteration 25: All 10 tests PASSED. Admin pricing persistence works ($74.04 Starter from DB, not hardcoded $29). TTS with OpenAI via Emergent key works (9 voices, audio generation). Edit Brain button visible in Admin > Agents. Commander returns processing status. Team page loads.

test_1_admin_pricing_persistence.description: GET /api/plans returns admin-configured prices. Starter is $74.04 (not hardcoded $29). Pro is $296.14+. Pricing loaded from DB on startup.

test_2_pricing_survives_restart.description: Server startup function loads pricing from 'platform_config' collection. SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS.update() applies DB values over hardcoded defaults.

test_3_tts_generate.description: POST /api/tts/generate with {text:'Hello world', voice:'nova'} returns audio_url with base64 data (18,583 chars). Uses OpenAI TTS via emergentintegrations.

test_4_tts_voices.description: GET /api/tts/voices returns 9 voices: alloy, nova, shimmer, echo, onyx, fable, coral, sage, ash

test_6_brain_editor_api.description: PUT /api/admin/agents/{agent_id}/brain saves personality_tone and rebuilds system_prompt with BRAIN CONFIG section

test_7_edit_brain_button_ui.description: Admin > Agents tab > expand agent row shows 'Edit Brain' button with brain icon next to 'Delete'

test_8_tts_ui_button.description: Chat with agent shows TTS button (Volume2 icon) on assistant messages. Works for regular agent responses (not Commander delegation).

test_9_team_page.description: GET /team loads team page with members list, owner/admin badges, invite button, and shared chats section

test_10_commander_processing.description: Commander POST returns immediately with commander_status='processing' for delegation requests. Background task coordination handled async.

critical_code_review_comments: Admin pricing persistence implemented correctly via startup() function loading from DB
TTS switched from ElevenLabs to OpenAI via emergentintegrations - working
Brain Editor saves and rebuilds system_prompt correctly
seed_data_creation: No new seed data - used existing admin account
